name: Unsweetened NutriMix 7+ Chocolate Nutrition Powder (350g)
subtitle: 100% Nutrition, Zero Added Sugar

description:
• Absolutely No Added Sugar! Unsweetened version of our bestseller, Nutrimix.

•  9g of Protein per serving. 

• Plant-based protein sources like moong dal, peas and brown rice.

• Developed by pediatricians & nutritionists. 

• 23 vitamins & minerals & superfoods like ragi, bajra, almonds & walnuts.

For 7 years and older, mix 2 scoops (20 grams) of the nutrition powder with 200 ml milk or water. 

 Optional - Add a sweetener of your choice 

Note: This is meant for immediate consumption after mixing.

reviews.author: Tanaz Pestonjee
reviews.title: Absolutely no added sugar
reviews.body: I never give my kids sugar. Brown, white, jaggery - I avoid all. This is a very good brand for clean, organic kids food. It's like Whole Truth but for kids.

reviews.author: Jhanvi Govil
reviews.title: Can control how much sweet to give kids
reviews.body: I like this better than jaggery nutrimix. Getting my kid used to less sweet things so I use this with some raw honey. Always liked Nutrimix for natural ingredients, finally this  unsweetened version.

reviews.author: Shweta Mathur
reviews.title: I made this happen!
reviews.body: I used to keep getting feedback calls from little joys and I mentioned only once that I love ur gummies but don't use nutrimix because it has jaggery and I don't want to give my kids anything sweet right now. It's amazing they launched a version without any sweetener in just 3 weeks! This brand actually listens to parents. I'm sure many careful parents also asked.
